code_examples.section: ltm rule event PEM SUBS SESS CREATED
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PEM_SUBS_SESS_CREATED
       This event is triggered when a subscriber session is created

DESCRIPTION
       This event is triggered when a subscriber session has been created.

Examples
	when PEM_SUBS_SESS_CREATED {
		PEM::session info 0.0.0.0 imsi 1223456
		PEM::session info 0.0.0.0 imeisv 2534535
		PEM::session info 0.0.0.0 tower-id 8248249
		PEM::session info 0.0.0.0 user-name 2139449

		log local0.  "imsi: [PEM::session info 0.0.0.0 imsi]"
		log local0.  "imeisv: [PEM::session info 0.0.0.0 imeisv]"
		log local0.  "tower-id: [PEM::session info 0.0.0.0 tower-id]"
		log local0.  "user-name: [PEM::session info 0.0.0.0 user-name]"
	    }

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.0.0 --First introduced the event.  @BIGIP-15.0.0 --Updated event with subscriber session context.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
